newsitem.title: USA: Northeast says Millstone exec to leave. [CORRECTED 23:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Northeast says Millstone exec to leave. [CORRECTED 23:00 GMT]

text.p: The head of Northeast Utilities Nuclear Group said Tuesday that the executive on loan from Carolina Power & Light Co, who had led the Millstone 3 plant's recovery program, will leave at the end of January.

John Paul Cowan, who joined Millstone in September of last year, has accepted a position at Florida Power Corp (corrects company name from Florida Power & Light Co), said Bruce Kenyon, president and chief executive of Northeast Utilities Nuclear Group, in a statement.
Kenyon said that the plant's recovery efforts will continue as scheduled, and that a replacement will be named. He did not elaborate.

Northeast shook up the management of its troubled nuclear units last September. The Millstone nuclear facility, which has a generation capacity of 2,700 megawatts, has been shut since March 31 of last year for safety reasons.
Kenyon said last month that all three Millstone plants should be ready for restart by early 1998, pending approval by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.
